column1: # Reviewed privileged-event jobs allowed on persistent runners (ADR 0235).
# The digest covers the job, its inherited workflow trigger/env/permissions/
# defaults, every calling job, and the scanned-tree bytes the job puts on disk:
# exact non-cone sparse paths, cone-mode directories with root and parent
# files, and local action directories. Any edit turns the entry STALE. A full
# checkout, a runtime-selected repository or ref, or a runtime git tree change
# needs the dynamic: field. Procedure: ADR 0235 decision 6.

column4: Runs only for merged PRs (trigger types: [closed], if: merged); sparse-checks out scripts/ci-gate/post-merge-reconcile.sh at pull_request.base.sha with persist-credentials false and executes only that script (its bytes are in this digest) plus inline gh/jq; head SHA/ref/repo are API identifiers; the merge-attestation-<run> artifact must come from a successful default-branch ai-review-merge.yml workflow_dispatch run and attestation.json is schema-validated with jq as data

workflow_run of actions-ci: sparse-checks out only scripts/ci-gate/review-policy-envelope.py from Verjson/.github and executes only that decoder plus inline gh/jq; the triggering run's head SHA and PRs are API identifiers; the ai-review-arm receipt is read as data with jq and review_policy is regex-bounded before decoding
column5: dynamic: its one checkout is Verjson/.github at steps.trusted-revision.outputs.sha, which the job sets from job.workflow_sha, the executing default-branch workflow revision that a workflow_run cannot take from the triggering PR; it sparse-checks out only scripts/ci-gate/review-policy-envelope.py (cone mode off), whose scanned bytes are in this digest

column4: Remote callee app-key-environment.yml pinned to full SHA ebe23faf: at that SHA it has no uses: or checkout step and no PR-head reference; validate runs on ubuntu-24.04 and validate-ai-review-key checks the App key environment inline
